limitations: One training checkpoint and one fixed sampled input set per host. Three timing orders are diagnostics, not across-workload confidence intervals.
No padding, native search, learner updates or concurrent role interference in the measured loops.
CPU evaluation and verified archival can overlap on separate physical CPU cores; shared host memory bandwidth is not isolated.
A numerical microbenchmark does not establish learning equivalence or production speedup.
primary: Transfer-inclusive latency for identical learned CNN predictions: serial small batches, queued same executable, and one wide executable. Report per-repetition slowest-host time and paired ratios; no rollout or MFU claim.
qualification: All four host artifacts present and finite; source/config/checkpoint/input hashes exact.
Queued outputs exactly equal serial outputs on every tested position.
Every timed repetition reproduces its own mode output exactly.
Report wide policy KL, total variation, top-action disagreements and absolute value/logit errors, with raw arrays. Wide execution may differ.
